# Glee-fully FoundRy collaboration

Read `AGENTS.md` before editing. Follow `docs/agent-collaboration.md` for task
ownership, Git reconciliation, handoffs and evidence. The owner prefers useful
results per token over speed and has a small Copilot allocation.

Accept a bounded task or focused diff review. Identify the assigned scope, base
SHA and branch; do not duplicate a running Replit or another agent's work. Keep
reviews focused on consequential defects in the requested diff. A reviewer does
not become an implementation worker without an explicit assignment.

This is an intentionally public repository with an owner-local Python/SQLite
application. Keep local records out of commits, preserve canon and seals, and
retain loopback binding and source allowlists. Public source is not authorization
for public hosting. Do not change sibling repositories or Skillz by implication.

Report changed paths, tested revision, check results, unresolved findings and one
next action. Read the current application guide for commands; do not invent a
build step. These instructions do not grant account access or change billing.
